Name: Asset Name Case Fixes (ANCF)
Author: Frantalcka
Description:
[left][b]PLATFORM[/b]
Linux and macOS only. On case-insensitive file systems (Windows) the mod detects this at startup and applies no patches.

[b]REQUIREMENTS[/b]
- Stardew Valley 1.6.14+
- SMAPI 4.x

[b]INSTALLATION[/b][/left]
[left][list=1]
[*]Extract the AssetNameCaseFixes folder into "Stardew Valley/Mods".[/*]
[*]Launch the game through SMAPI.[/*]
[/list][b]HOW IT WORKS[/b]
At startup the mod indexes the Content folder and builds a case-insensitive map of asset names. Harmony prefixes then rewrite requested names before they reach the content pipeline:
- StardewModdingAPI.Framework.Content.AssetName.Parse(string, ...), which covers helper.GameContent.Load<T>(string), Content Patcher, and other string-based asset requests.
- ContentManager.OpenStream(string) and LocalizedContentManager.OpenStream(string), which cover direct Game1.content.Load<T>(string) calls.
Patches are wrapped in try/catch. If a patch cannot be applied, a warning is written to the SMAPI log and the game continues.

[b]WHAT IT FIXES[/b]
Any mod that requests a vanilla Content asset with the wrong letter case.[/left]
[left][/left]
[left]Known case:[/left]
[left]Fixes Ridgeside Village (RSV) quests missing from the bulletin board. RSV requests "data/quests" instead of "Data/Quests", so the file is not found on case-sensitive file systems.

[b]LIMITATIONS[/b]
- Missing assets are not created or substituted.
- Asset type mismatches are not corrected (e.g. requesting Texture2D for a data dictionary).
- Paths inside Mods/ are not affected.
- Errors in mod data (invalid JSON/XNB, wrong keys) are not corrected.

[b]COMPATIBILITY[/b]
Does not alter mod logic and does not add or replace game assets. Safe to remove at any time.

[b]SOURCE[/b]
[url=https://github.com/Frantalcka/ANCF]GitHub[/url][/left]

Manifest.Name: Asset Name Case Fixes
Manifest.Description: Automatically resolves content asset names to the real capitalization of the files in the game's Content folder. Fixes mods which request assets like 'data/quests' on case-sensitive file systems (Linux/macOS).
Manifest.Author: Frantalcka
